name: @superatom/ui
description: The platform's one UI framework: every surface (the user UI, a dashboard, the control plane, a program's view) is built from it — the design system (slob's, plain CSS), the shell (where to go, the thread, the artifacts), the thread's frames and branches, the one answer component and its block renderers, paths from here, <Intent> with one listener, and the loader that brings a program's React side in with the platform's own libraries.
